success.aggregation: Equal three regions, paired rainfall loss ratios; expose every regional regression; no individual rain veto.
success.interpretation: Both fixed thermal patterns are scored against original-wind controls separately, with all four ocean/pattern comparisons reported. No adoption or independent validation. If split fails, move to dynamically forced circulation/energy, not more kinematic/profile tuning.

plan.predicted_signature: Retain original lower convergence and mass return while changing upper rotational flow; test actual rainfall gain versus original winds under both fixed temperature laws.
plan.fixed_approximations: A=modeled Tsl, B=modeled zonal EBM Tz, both common101325Pa references smoothed500km; raw T=[B+(A-B)*sigma^a]*sigma^kappa with200K floor. Nominal a=1/(-log(.75)) from existing dry lower-layer depth. Warm anomaly a capped by dry-adiabatic stability using Rd,cp1004,g. No observed wind/humidity/T forcing for this law; inherited observational backgrounds remain fixed. Diagnostic profile only, no vertical energy/convective-adjustment claim.
plan.architecture_limit: Total raw thermal shear is not imposed. Target is historical divergent shear plus projected mass-balanced thermal shear. Neither new vertical energy nor new diabatic heating/momentum equations are solved.
